This model of '''Rakatan ship''' was used by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].

==History==
[[File:RakataFleetDotJ.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[Star Forge]] and a fleet of Rakatan ships are seen in a vision.]]
These vessels were created after the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] uplifted the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] civilization of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] who were taught the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and were given advanced technology. With these gifts, the Rakata began a campaign of conquest where they conquered, enslaved and destroyed worlds with fleets of these starships.<ref name="DotJ:TPoB4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 4]]</ref>

The [[Devourer (Rakatan ship)|''Devourer'']] was a ship of this design. It crashed on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], with all but one crewmember lost. On the planet, the [[Je'daii]] had a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of a fleet of these craft that were present at the [[Star Forge]].
